title: Arrangements and stock charts for the band
summary: The band mostly used stocks plus a few arrangements by band members and a schoolteacher pianist whose band played only one job.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Oh you were? Yeah. I've got the third reel on now. I forgot what we were talking about then. We were talking about Joe H. Williams and I wanted to ask you, what about arrangers? Did you have any specials? Did you use stocks or what?

Well we were mostly stocking. Now we have a few little arrangers that Pickett wrote for us. John Buhlner, he wrote some little arrangers for the band. Thelow Riley used to do it too. Because he was working in the band too at the time. He used to write some arrangers for us. Then we had Walker. I can't think of Walker for his name. He was a piano player. He's a school teacher too. Sigmund Walker. Oh yeah, I know who you're talking about. He was working in the darks too, and he used to write some numbers. He had a band and it rehearsed for years. He did. That's right. And they saw him there after they rehearsed. Well I'm sure him was in the band. Did they ever get a job? I think they played one job. Oh wow.
One job. One job. That's all. One job. He's a good musician. I'm telling you. Yeah.
